plugin.name: Deep Populate
plugin.description: Automatically populate all nested relations in a single request.
settings.subtitle: Configure the defaults used when deeply populating content.
settings.useCache.label: Use cache
settings.useCache.description: Cache resolved populate objects in the database.
settings.replaceWildcard.label: Replace wildcard populate
settings.replaceWildcard.description: Turn `populate: '*'` requests into a deeply populated response.
settings.omitEmpty.label: Omit empty relations
settings.omitEmpty.description: Leave relations without any value out of the populate object.
settings.localizations.label: Include localizations
settings.localizations.description: Populate the localizations of localized content types.
settings.clearCacheOnStartup.label: Clear cache on startup
settings.clearCacheOnStartup.description: Remove all cached populate objects when Strapi starts.
settings.warmOnWrite.label: Warm cache on write
settings.warmOnWrite.description: Re-warm cached entries after a document is updated. This can be slow.
ctb.section.title: Deep Populate
ctb.allow.label: Allowed relations and components
ctb.allow.description: Restrict deep population to these relations and components.
ctb.deny.label: Denied relations and components
ctb.deny.description: Stop deep population at these relations and components.
ctb.allowDeny.error: Could not load content types and components
